opening.argument: The presentation promotes Mirror Trading International as an automated Bitcoin trading pool intended to grow members' Bitcoin and generate passive income. It describes the company as "offering crypto trading services by using an automated system to trade with a trading pool on behalf of its members" and expressly connects MTI with "make a passive income with MTI." The program also solicits team-building through "an optional referral program for networkers who like to build a team," alongside "referral, binary and leadership bonuses" paid weekly on recurring volume. Although the speaker denies guarantees, that qualification does not change the adjudicated program being promoted: a pool operation for which a federal court later found MTI liable for fraud.
